shared_synthesis_notes_for_root: Keep Murex and RATAN feed windows, identity fields, and status meanings source- and cohort-specific.
Do not promote historical demo rows or runbook instructions into executed results.
Keep cashflow lifecycle conflicts separate from scheduled auto-netting, destination accounting, and splitting rules.
Treat onboarding and integration checklists as requested or documented scope, not activation evidence.
Preserve the DR/PROD migration boundary and require retained reconciliation evidence before describing control removal.
Keep cutoff and READY-state action matrices from January and October release controls source-specific until their boundary and precedence are answered.
Keep the AutoDVP external-account scope, country-count difference, Murex/Stella linkage, and missing replay/deduplication evidence explicit.
Do not merge feed variants: EBBS direct events, Aspire batch files, and Korea OLTP retain different schedules, retries, and acknowledgment contracts.
Preserve HAU BIC spelling, PVP/DVP, and MT605/MT692 conflicts; no static or rollout evidence was inspected.
Reuse the existing auto-netting rule-selection and grouping concepts; their scope does not approve candidate static values.
Treat lock, cache, FileIT, and aggregation configurations as historical proposals pending consumer and environment evidence.
